_note: The 'what's new since you left' bullets in the ~1-month win-back email (scripts/send-winback.mts reads this; core/mailer.ts renders it). Edit freely to keep the email evergreen — no code change or redeploy of the app is needed, the next send picks it up. Keep it to 2-4 punchy items; 'title' is bolded, 'body' follows an em-dash. If this file is missing or invalid, the sender falls back to DEFAULT_WINBACK_HIGHLIGHTS in core/mailer.ts. Keep in sync with the August 2026 campaign copy in docs/newsletters/2026-08-product-update-*.txt and the /updates entry (app/updates/page.tsx).

highlights.title: Your levels on your own chart
highlights.body: a free TradingView script that draws the Gamma Flip, Call Wall, Put Wall and Max Pain on SPY, SPX, QQQ, NDX, ES or NQ — and a NinjaTrader 8 indicator, included with Pro, that polls the API and keeps those levels plus Pin Strike and VWAP current on their own.

highlights.title: ES and NQ
highlights.body: futures are first-class now — their own gamma levels, their own free pages, and the same read as SPY, SPX, QQQ and NDX everywhere else, converted to futures prices on the live basis.

highlights.title: Gamma Shift
highlights.body: what changed, not just where things stand: the per-strike move in dealer gamma between two points in time, with expiry roll-off separated out so it doesn't read as fresh positioning.

highlights.title: Three new metrics
highlights.body: Market Tide folds gamma and flow across the covered indices into one bearish-to-bullish score, Pair Comparison puts any two indices side by side on strike-aligned Net GEX ladders with a replay scrubber, and Volatility charts put/call IV skew against realized-versus-implied.
